pozycje.lead: A quantum processor with 48 error-corrected logical qubits completed a molecular simulation that classical hardware needs days to approximate, researchers report.

treść: A quantum processor with 48 error-corrected logical qubits completed a molecular simulation that classical hardware needs days to approximate, researchers report.
The team ran a chemistry simulation on 48 logical qubits assembled from 1,200 physical ones, with error rates below the threshold for the first time in a practical workload.

pozycje.nagłówek: Muon magnetic moment measured to 127 parts per billion, tension with theory persists
pozycje.lead: Fermilab's Muon g-2 collaboration released its final analysis, based on six years of data and 21 times the statistics of the original Brookhaven experiment.

treść: Fermilab's Muon g-2 collaboration released its final analysis, based on six years of data and 21 times the statistics of the original Brookhaven experiment.
The final dataset from Fermilab pins the muon magnetic moment to 127 parts per billion, four times more precise than the 2021 measurement.
The gap with theory now stands at 5.1 sigma.
